title: Symfony UX 3.6 released
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony UX 3.6 is out, with more than 100 pull requests merged since 3.5.1. It
adds three experimental packages, UX Inspector, UX Image and UX Router, aligns
the Shadcn kit of the UX Toolkit with the Nova style, and runs every Toolkit
recipe in a real browser,…</body></html>
author: Hugo Alliaume
